content.text:
I added the notice to the top of [.github/pull_request_template.md](.github/pull_request_template.md), so it's the first thing contributors see when they open a PR:

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Code freeze for Maester 3.0:** from 7 November 2026 we will only merge bug fixes while we get ready to release Maester 3.0 next week. New features and new tests opened after that will be reviewed after the release.

I used a fixed date instead of "in the next 48 hours" because the template text stays the same over time, so a relative deadline would soon be wrong.

The notice isn't hidden in a comment, so it will appear in every new PR description unless the contributor deletes it. Remove it from the template once 3.0 is out.

Nothing is committed yet. The edit is on your current branch, `feat/console-status-pill`, which is about the console, not this. It only affects new PRs once it's merged into `main`.
